T1_inverse_system.statement: Resolution approximants with bonding/restriction maps form a natural inverse system; coherent identity is represented by a compatible thread through all levels.

T2_finite_resolution_equivalence.statement: Two identities can share all coarse approximants through depth R and split at R+1.

T3_history_refines_residual_fiber.statement: When projection refinement leaves a residual fiber, ordered History can further restrict/select the admissible lift without changing the projection seed.

T4_canonical_equivalence_candidate.statement: Identity equivalence at Resolution R is naturally equivalence/isomorphism of coherent projection-lift towers through R, with designated preserved invariants and History witness.
